typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	ETPPImporttableDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		DATABASE_CATALOG_WF_GUID as string,
		BUSINESS_INTEREST_TYPE as string,
		BUS_INT_TYPE_DESCRIPTION as string,
		SYS_CLASS_NAME as string,
		SYS_CLASS_DESCRIPTION as string,
		CORRELATION_ID as string,
		DBSMART_DATABASE_ID as string,
		ENVIRONMENT_ID as string,
		ENVIRONMENT_DESCRIPTION as string,
		MANAGED_BY_GROUP_GUID as string,
		MANAGED_BY_GROUP_NAME as string,
		NAME as string,
		OPERATIONAL_STATUS as string,
		OPERATIONAL_STATUS_DESCRIPTION as string,
		OPERATIONAL_STATUS_GROUP as string,
		OWNED_BY_GROUP_GUID as string,
		OWNED_BY_GROUP_NAME as string,
		SUPPORT_GROUP_GUID as string,
		SUPPORT_GROUP_NAME as string,
		SHORT_DESCRIPTION as string,
		SYS_CREATED_ON as timestamp,
		SYS_UPDATED_ON as timestamp,
		SYS_CREATED_BY as string,
		SYS_UPDATED_BY as string,
		TODSH_BUSINESS_EFFECTIVE_DATE as timestamp,
		MODEL_ID_GUID as string,
		MODEL_NAME as string,
		MANUFACTURER_GUID as string,
		MANUFACTURER as string,
		MODEL_NUMBER as string,
		DISCOVERY_SOURCE as string,
		U_SERVICENOW_DISCOVERED as timestamp,
		LAST_DISCOVERED as timestamp,
		DISTRIBUTED_APP_ID as string,
		BUSINESS_APPLICATION_WF_GUID as string,
		CHILD_NAME as string,
		CHILD_WF_GUID as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> OracleDatalakeSourceQuery
OracleDatalakeSourceQuery derive(ImportDate = currentTimestamp()) ~> DerivedColumnAddImportDate
DerivedColumnAddImportDate sink(input(
		operational_status_description as string,
		short_description as string,
		operational_status as string,
		environment_id as string,
		dbsmart_database_id as string,
		sys_updated_on as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		u_servicenow_discovered as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		last_discovered as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		child_name as string,
		sys_class_name as string,
		manufacturer as string,
		managed_by_group_guid as string,
		environment_description as string,
		sys_updated_by as string,
		discovery_source as string,
		model_name as string,
		sys_created_on as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		managed_by_group_name as string,
		bus_int_type_description as string,
		model_id_guid as string,
		model_number as string,
		sys_class_description as string,
		business_application_wf_guid as string,
		sys_created_by as string,
		distributed_app_id as string,
		operational_status_group as string,
		business_interest_type as string,
		importdate as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		database_catalog_wf_guid as string,
		todsh_business_effective_date as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		owned_by_group_guid as string,
		support_group_name as string,
		owned_by_group_name as string,
		name as string,
		manufacturer_guid as string,
		correlation_id as string,
		support_group_guid as string,
		child_wf_guid as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		operational_status_description = OPERATIONAL_STATUS_DESCRIPTION,
		short_description = SHORT_DESCRIPTION,
		operational_status = OPERATIONAL_STATUS,
		environment_id = ENVIRONMENT_ID,
		dbsmart_database_id = DBSMART_DATABASE_ID,
		sys_updated_on = SYS_UPDATED_ON,
		u_servicenow_discovered = U_SERVICENOW_DISCOVERED,
		last_discovered = LAST_DISCOVERED,
		child_name = CHILD_NAME,
		sys_class_name = SYS_CLASS_NAME,
		manufacturer = MANUFACTURER,
		managed_by_group_guid = MANAGED_BY_GROUP_GUID,
		environment_description = ENVIRONMENT_DESCRIPTION,
		sys_updated_by = SYS_UPDATED_BY,
		discovery_source = DISCOVERY_SOURCE,
		model_name = MODEL_NAME,
		sys_created_on = SYS_CREATED_ON,
		managed_by_group_name = MANAGED_BY_GROUP_NAME,
		bus_int_type_description = BUS_INT_TYPE_DESCRIPTION,
		model_id_guid = MODEL_ID_GUID,
		model_number = MODEL_NUMBER,
		sys_class_description = SYS_CLASS_DESCRIPTION,
		business_application_wf_guid = BUSINESS_APPLICATION_WF_GUID,
		sys_created_by = SYS_CREATED_BY,
		distributed_app_id = DISTRIBUTED_APP_ID,
		operational_status_group = OPERATIONAL_STATUS_GROUP,
		business_interest_type = BUSINESS_INTEREST_TYPE,
		importdate = ImportDate,
		database_catalog_wf_guid = DATABASE_CATALOG_WF_GUID,
		todsh_business_effective_date = TODSH_BUSINESS_EFFECTIVE_DATE,
		owned_by_group_guid = OWNED_BY_GROUP_GUID,
		support_group_name = SUPPORT_GROUP_NAME,
		owned_by_group_name = OWNED_BY_GROUP_NAME,
		name = NAME,
		manufacturer_guid = MANUFACTURER_GUID,
		correlation_id = CORRELATION_ID,
		support_group_guid = SUPPORT_GROUP_GUID,
		child_wf_guid = CHILD_WF_GUID),
	partitionFileNames:[($ETPPImporttableDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> ETPPImporttableDestination
